LanguageData.DMS_Gun_Dawnblade.label: Dawnblade
LanguageData.DMS_Gun_Dawnblade.description: Full designation: Type 85 Multi-Purpose Quick-Firing Cannon System "Dawnblade", a highly automated revolver-type quick-firing cannon system widely used on the colonial fleet's small and medium ships and in colonies' ground-based defense systems.
LanguageData.DMS_Gun_Dawnblade.verbs.Verb_Shoot.label: Dawnblade
LanguageData.DMS_Gun_GateKeeper.label: Gatekeeper
LanguageData.DMS_Gun_GateKeeper.description: A heavy Gatling autocannon whose extremely high rate of fire and devastating suppression capability led the colonial fleet to adopt it as the close-in defense system for spacecraft and surface vessels. It is also frequently installed in colonies as part of their defenses.
LanguageData.DMS_Gun_Kord.label: Kord
LanguageData.DMS_Gun_Kord.description: A modern heavy machine gun with considerable reliability.

LanguageData.DMS_Gun_MK44_Navy.label: MK44 BushMaster-II
LanguageData.DMS_Gun_MK44_Navy.description: The 30x173mm MK44 Bushmaster II autocannon, despite its modest 200 RPM rate of fire, achieves reliable defensive performance through good accuracy and adequate lethality.
LanguageData.DMS_Gun_MK44_Navy.verbs.Verb_Shoot.label: MK44 BushMaster-II
LanguageData.DMS_Gun_Vasilek.label: 2B9M vasilek
LanguageData.DMS_Gun_Vasilek.description: An ancient but effective rapid-fire mortar design, capable of firing four mortar rounds in one burst to blanket the target area.
LanguageData.DMS_Gun_Vasilek.verbs.Verb_Shoot.label: 2B9M vasilek
LanguageData.DMS_Turret_Dawnblade.label: Dawnblade
LanguageData.DMS_Turret_Dawnblade.description: A multi-purpose quick-firing cannon system widely fielded by the colonial fleet, using drum magazines and a revolver loader to intercept and engage small and medium high-speed targets. It provides ferocious large-caliber direct fire support for colony defense.
LanguageData.DMS_Turret_Dawnblade.comps.CompRefuelabl: Cannot fire: Needs new reinforced barrel.
LanguageData.DMS_Turret_GateKeeper.label: Gatekeeper
LanguageData.DMS_Turret_GateKeeper.description: A heavy close-in defense turret fitted with a 30mm multi-barrel autocannon, whose extremely high rate of fire creates a dense, lethal wall of metal in a very short time.
LanguageData.DMS_Turret_GateKeeper.comps.CompRefuelab: Cannot shoot: Needs new reinforced barrel.
LanguageData.DMS_Turret_MK44_Navy.label: MK44 BushMaster-II
LanguageData.DMS_Turret_MK44_Navy.description: The Bushmaster II autocannon, firing 30x173mm NATO ammunition. Despite its modest 200 RPM rate of fire, it achieves reliable defensive performance through good accuracy and adequate lethality, effectively serving as a precision point-fire autocannon.
LanguageData.DMS_Turret_MK44_Navy.comps.CompRefuelabl: Cannot shoot: Needs new reinforced barrel.
LanguageData.DMS_Turret_Okhotnik.label: Okhotnik
LanguageData.DMS_Turret_Okhotnik.description: An ancient design of a remote controlled turret widely used on armored vehicles and mech armor platforms.
LanguageData.DMS_Turret_Okhotnik.comps.CompRefuelable: Cannot shoot: Needs new reinforced barrel.
LanguageData.DMS_Turret_Sentry.label: Sentry turret
LanguageData.DMS_Turret_Sentry.description: A light automatic turret with a built-in battery, designed to be carried and set up wherever the line needs a gun. On the power grid it charges its internal cell; cut off from the grid it draws on that reserve and keeps firing until the cell runs dry. Switching it off puts it on standby: it stops watching and pours the saved power into the cell instead, charging twice as fast.\n\nIts tripod folds flat, so a drafted operator can pick it up, carry it forward and drop it into position on the spot. A cell charged before departure will keep it standing watch for days.
LanguageData.DMS_Turret_Vasilek.label: Vasilek
LanguageData.DMS_Turret_Vasilek.description: An ancient design of a rapid fire indirect artillery piece capable of firing four mortar rounds in one burst.
Cannot fire: Needs new reinforced barrel.
